questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some books are novels.

All novels are texts.

**Conclusions:**

I. All texts are novels.

II. Some books are texts.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements will be as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b477d27dd040034cbabe4252e01f60370d1295783da50dc9565ba5c4de88cd8.png] 

I. All texts are novels → **False** (As we can see some texts are novels. Hence, the possibility of this statement is possible but a definite conclusion is not valid.)

II. Some books are texts → **True** (As we can see all novels are texts and some part of novels is also a book. Hence, this conclusion is valid.)

Hence, **"Only conclusion II follows"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following number series?

12, 24, 36, 46, 56, ?, 72
questions.solution:
**Given series**: 12, 24, 36, 46, 56, ?, 72

The logic followed here is:

**Even numbers starting 12 are added to two terms, then 10 are added to the next two terms, and so on.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/139b75ee5e229bcbf27d8d6f9764a9367312934d5dd88c5fe28a7c516c9f9948.png] 

 
• 12 + **12** = 24
 
• 24 + **12** = 36
 
• 36 + **10** = 46 
 
• 46 + **10** = 56
 
• 56 + **8** = **64** 
 
• 64 + **8** = 72

Hence, the correct answer is **64**.

questions.question: If in a coding system DAYCARE is coded as 54 and JOURNEY is coded as 105, then how will FURTHER be coded in the same coding system?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The logic followed here is:-

(Sum of the place value of the letters in a word) - 3

DAYCARE = 54

(Sum of the place value of letters of the word DAYCARE) - 3

[D(4) + A(1) + Y(25) + C(3) + A(1) + R(18) + E(5)] - 3

= (4 + 1 + 25 + 3 + 1 + 18 + 5) - 3

= 57 - 3

= 54.

And,

(Sum of the place value of letters of the word JOURNEY) - 3

[J(10) + O(15) + U(21) + R(18) + N(14) + E(5) + Y(25)] - 3

= (10 + 15 + 21 + 18 + 14 + 5 + 25) - 3

= 108 - 3

= 105.

Similarly, 

**(Sum of the place value of letters of the word FURTHER) - 3**

**[F(6) + U(21) + R(18) + T(20) + H(8) + E(5) + R(18)] - 3**

**= (6 + 21 + 18 + 20 + 8 + 5 + 18) - 3**

**= 96 - 3**

= **93.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"option 4"**.

questions.question: Ritik is ranked 6th from top in his class, while Akshay is 18th from bottom. If their position is interchanged, Akshay gets 15th from bottom. What is the number of students in the class?
questions.solution:
Given,

 
• Ritik is 6th from top and Akshay 18th is from bottom.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e63600078ce261267cac0f802f828806b423a9e263a2c47a60dc00524fae6e24.png] 

 
• When Ritik and Akshay interchange their position,Ritik becomes 18th from bottom and Akshay becomes 6th from top and 15th from bottom.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a7ad63115761cf1f5d6b8e1301007410c62737ddfd29000a8ce733611795f43.png] 

**Total number of students = Position from bottom + Position from top - 1**

= 15 + 6 - 1

= 21 - 1 

= 20 Students

Hence, the correct answer is **"20".**
